reviewItem.question: Does "Updated the redirection method used in Ambient from `TPROXY` to `REDIRECT`. For most users, this should have no impact, but fixes a few compatibility issues…" mean a change to protocol-behavior:istio|name=ambient-redirection-method (value-changed)?
